messages:
marta: quick brain-dump: propose a "filterset recommendation" UX on the route page that also surfaces signal debiasing (dont over-prioritize spiky models). want to align on data model + preview API.

jin: can you define debiasing? is this about traffic skew, cold-starts, or prompt coverage gaps?

marta: all of the above. core idea: recommendations score = raw_signal_score * calibration_factor where calibration uses traffic entropy, cold-start fraction, and coverage overlap.

leo: we need a minimal API for previewing impact. something like:
```
GET /api/v1/routes/{route_id}/recommendations/preview?window=24h&debias=true
returns: [ { id: "rec-33", filterset: "model:small-quant", score: 0.67, est: { cost_delta_pct: -8.2, p50_ms: 12, p95_ms: 70 }, meta: "debias:traffic_entropy=0.34" } ]
```

jin: preview must include sample size and a coverage_risk metric. if coverage_risk>0.3 we should surface a warning.

marta: agreed. add n_samples and coverage_risk. also add a provenance token so we can reproduce the recommendation later.

ops-bot: stream-sugg job complete for route r-api (job=stream-sugg-20240501-3) :sparkles: generated 5 candidates.

leo: approval rules: anything that reduces estimated coverage (coverage_risk > medium) or increases cost by >15% must route to approval queue. finance-bot should be pinged automatically.

finance-bot: auto-note: approvals will require budget_owner + finance sign-off for cost increases >15%.

jin: rollout modes we support: preview (UI-only), canary (5-10% traffic), and staged (gradual ramp via routing policies). canary must record pre/post histograms and allow 1-click rollback.

marta: telemetry must record the scoring inputs (entropy, cold_start_frac, eval_delta) and the raw samples used for preview (PII-sanitized). store as a compressed trace referenced by recommendation_id.

leo: UX ask: show a sparklines row with pre/post p50,p95 and token burn and a small badge for "coverage risk" and "debias factor". clicking badge shows the trace.

jin: operational metrics: track suggestion_adoption_rate, avg_cost_delta_realized, reversion_rate_24h. these will help tune calibration_factor.

marta: ok I'll draft RFC with: data model, preview API, apply flow, approval rules, telemetry snapshot schema, and metrics. can someone volunteer a quick spike to wire preview->sampling API?

leo: I can spike for 2d.

marta: thanks! opening RFC after spike. :white_check_mark:
